reviewMethod: Antigravity drafts separately reviewed against complete archived version bodies and source notes; source discrepancies retained explicitly.

headings.title: Exemption from corporate farming restrictions for swine production in specified counties
headings.reviewNote: Verified sub 1(1)-(3): exempts agricultural land in use as of Sept. 28, 2007 by a corporation, LLC, or LLP for swine production in three described third-class county population/government tiers from § 350.015.

headings.title: Prohibition on expanding swine operations and permitted building maintenance
headings.reviewNote: Verified sub 2: bars expanding operations (including contiguous land purchase or new/expanded animal housing), while permitting repair, maintenance, rebuilding, or activities required by state or federal law.

entries.reviewSummary: Independently read archived § 350.017 (bid 18656), both subsections with subdivisions (1)-(3), and source note (L. 2012 S.B. 631). Verified Sept. 28, 2007 swine-production exemption in three described third-class county tiers and no-expansion rule with maintenance/compliance carve-out. Retained both titles.

headings.title: Farming corporation initial reporting requirements and contents
headings.reviewNote: Verified sub 1(1)-(4): corporations farming or proposing to farm after Sept. 28, 1975 must file a report with the agriculture director listing incorporation, agent/office, land parcels, and officers/directors.

headings.title: Additional report contents for family or authorized farm corporations
headings.reviewNote: Verified sub 2(1)-(3): additional disclosures for family farm or authorized farm corporations (shares held by farm-resident/active farmers and 3rd-degree relatives, shareholder list, nonfarm net-receipt percentage).

headings.title: Report filing prerequisite prior to commencing farming
headings.reviewNote: Verified sub 3: no corporation may commence farming in Missouri until it has filed the required § 350.020 report.

headings.title: Event-triggered update reports for nonfamily farm corporations
headings.reviewNote: Verified sub 4(1)-(3): farming corporations other than family farm corporations must file updated sub 1 reports upon info changes, controlling-interest changes, or land sale/cessation of farming.

headings.title: Criminal misdemeanor penalty and fines for failure to file or false reports
headings.reviewNote: Verified sub 5: failure to file a required report or use of false information is a misdemeanor punishable by a fine of $500 to $1,000.

entries.reviewSummary: Independently read archived § 350.020 (bid 18657), all five subsections with subdivisions, and history notes (L. 1975 H.B. 655 § 3, A.L. 1979 S.B. 41). Verified initial and event-triggered farming reports, family/authorized farm disclosures, pre-farming filing bar, and $500–$1,000 misdemeanor fine. Retained all five titles.
